detail.longDescription: Alright. It’s taken a couple of days of really intense (and frustrating) turbo-nerding but I’ve managed to migrate two of my three instances over to the Docker host. I’ve save the last one till last as it hosts a few other people, so I want to be sure that things are stable and working well before I start messing around with it. 😆 The next steps are to come up with a new nightly backup routine and ultimately move the Docker host out of a VM and onto bare metal, which should result in a good performance gain. Long-term I’d like to move to an official GitchSoc image. Right now I’m using one provided by LSIO, which works great, but I don’t love the idea of being one step removed from the official source. So far though I’ve had a hell of a time trying to spin up a native Glitch image. More learning needed… # SelfHost # SelfHosted # SelfHosting
